text: Wait. Is that crate seven? In the lift? Nothing rides the lift but you. Crates stay in their rooms. That is the entire point of rooms.
I am not going to make a fuss. I am going to make a note. The note is mostly exclamation marks.
What was that. Where did it go. There is no slot on that wall. I have the drawings. There has never been a slot on that wall.
Somebody built it. Somebody labelled it in tape, in the same hand as the seven. Somebody has been in my walls.
That is a bonus. I have taken thirty seconds off your time. I did not decide to. My hands did it. I do not have hands.
